question: Indian classical violinist Annavarapu Rama Swamy was awarded with the __________ in 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Annavarapu Rama Swamy** is a renowned Indian classical violinist known for his significant contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• In recognition of his contributions, he was awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2021.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• This award is given for distinguished service in any field including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors of India announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• They are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of a high order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service in any field).
 
• The awards were instituted in 1954 and are awarded by the Government of India.
 
• The Padma Awards recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**
 
 
• It is the national academy for music, dance, and drama in India.
 
• It was created by a resolution of the Ministry of Education, Government of India in 1952 and became functional the following year.
 
• The Akademi's fellowship and awards are considered the highest national recognition given to practicing artists.
 
• It is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India, preceded by the Bharat Ratna and the Padma Vibhushan and followed by the Padma Shri.
 
• It is awarded for "distinguished service of a high order... without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex."
 
• The award was established on 2 January 1954 by the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award of the Republic of India, after the Bharat Ratna.
 
• It is awarded for "exceptional and distinguished service," without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• The award was instituted by the Government of India on 2 January 1954.
